topic: Why NASA Lost a $327M Mars Orbiter Over Metric Units
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

NASA lost a $327 million Mars orbiter because two teams used different units of measurement!

Here is the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Lockheed Martin's software calculated thruster impulse in 'pound-seconds' (imperial units).
🔹 NASA's navigation software expected those calculations to be in 'newton-seconds' (metric units).
🔹 This tiny oversight caused the Mars Climate Orbiter to enter Mars' atmosphere too low, leading to its incineration.
